contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-336), probably a Soli Invicto Comiti issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate and cuirassed left, shield in front. Obverse inscription: [--]TINVS[--]AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left. Reverse inscription: probably SOLI INVICTO COMITI. Diameter: 22.0mm, Weight: 3.39gms, die axis: 6
